<thought>All subnetworks are to be combined into a single circuit. Each resistor must have a unique identifier, so I renamed the overlapping IDs (R1, R2, R3) by appending the subnet number. The connections are taken directly from the three provided subnet descriptions, preserving node names. This yields a topology with eight resistors, matching the note that the total number of resistors is 8.</thought>
